messages:
Priya: Quick thread — finalizing the launch post hero + snackable hooks. Need: 1) legal check on benchmark claim 2) final hero copy 3) webinar seatmap (demo slots) and lead routing (UTMs) 4) confirm images from design.

Alex: Re: benchmark claim — what's the exact phrasing you plan to use?

Priya: Thinking: "Redwood cuts inference cost by up to 4x vs unmanaged GPU endpoints for typical chat workloads." Is that conservative enough? :thinking: 

Marta: That's pretty strong. We tested on v2 models, median seq len ~120. Legal will want the dataset and test window referenced.

Ethan: Can we rephrase to "up to 4x on average in our internal benchmarks" and link to the benchmark appendix? avoids absolute language.

Priya: Good call. Alex, can you add a link to the appendix? "internal benchmarks (see appendix)" is okay?

Alex: Yep. I'll add a short anchor to the appendix and swap the line to "up to 4x on average in our internal benchmarks (see appendix)."

LegalBot: /legal-check: Claim flagged for supporting data. Please attach benchmark dates, model versions, and test config (seq len, batch size, hardware).

Alex: Pasted results: model=gpt-like-v2, hw=A100-80GB, seq=120, batch=8, date=2025-03-07. I'll add a short table in the appendix.

Marta: Suggest adding a short sentence: "Results vary by model and workload; see full methodology." Legal likes the hedge.

LegalBot: That phrasing is fine. Approve pending inclusion of methodology link.

DesignTeam: Hi! New hero mock is up: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/launch-hero —please check image alt text and crop. I pushed two variants (A/B) in the file.

Priya: Thanks — prefer Variant B (clean left-aligned copy). Can we reserve hero alt: "Developer editing inference routing dashboard"?

DesignTeam: Yup, alt added. Also exported web-optimized hero at 1200x628.

Tom: Webinar seatmap: we have 3 demo slots per session, 5 sessions on launch day. We should mark two sessions as "priority for enterprise leads" and route enterprise registrants to a sales queue.

Priya: For lead routing, add UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_q2, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. Enterprise flag should add tag=enterprise and route to /sales/enterprise in HubSpot.

Ethan: I'll add hidden form field "enterprise=true" when company size >250 in registration flow and map it to the tag.

Priya: Can marketing ops verify HubSpot mapping and a draft workflow? Need it live before publish.

Alex: Ops check: workflow drafted, but need final tag names and test registrant to confirm webhooks.

DesignTeam: Quick QA — social cards look fine. One ask: reduce headline line-height slightly for mobile.

Priya: Noted. Alex + DesignTeam please iterate and push final assets to /marketing/launch/assets by EOD PST.

Marta: One more: add a two-sentence note under the webinar CTA about demo availability to avoid overpromising.

Priya: Proposed: "Live demos available during scheduled sessions — additional enterprise-only slots available on request." OK?

LegalBot: Approved.

Tom: I'll seed 10 demo seats for partners and mark them reserved.

Priya: Awesome. Final checklist: benchmark appendix link + method, hero asset final, legal approved copy, HubSpot routing tested, webinar seatmap set. Anyone blocking?

Ethan: I'm on HubSpot test now; should finish in 60–90m.

Alex: I'll update the post copy and appendix now.

DesignTeam: Exporting final assets in 30m.

Priya: Great—if all green by 18:00 PT we can go live tomorrow morning. :rocket:

Tom: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate demo invites.

Marta: Thanks team — leaving a quick QA pass before publish. :eyes:
